name: tax-formalization
description: Open, verifiable formalization of the IRS individual income tax forms-and-instructions layer, plus a guided self-preparation tool as its first client.

scripts.build: npm run compile --silent && node engine/dist/main.js build
scripts.stage1: npm run build --silent && npm run render --silent
scripts.record-fixtures: npm run compile --silent && node engine/dist/main.js record-fixtures
scripts.check-all: python3 tools/fetch_sources.py && npm run build --silent && npm run render --silent && node engine/dist/main.js conjecture && node engine/dist/main.js test-fixtures && node engine/dist/main.js test-integration && node engine/dist/main.js coverage && node engine/dist/main.js mutate && npm run compare --silent && node engine/dist/main.js review-stage2 && node engine/dist/main.js review-stage3 && node engine/dist/main.js review-stage4
scripts.compare: cd lean && lake build taxeval >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd .. && npm run compile --silent && node engine/dist/main.js compare
